name: grok
description: Delegate tasks to Grok on your Grok subscription (SuperGrok / X Premium) from inside Codex, with in-chat OAuth login via the bundled MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate any task to Grok on your Grok subscription — questions, research, code, cross-vendor review.
interface.longDescription: Grok becomes a delegate the parent agent can hand work to: questions, research, analysis, code to write or debug, and independent cross-vendor code review. Runs on the user's Grok subscription (SuperGrok or X Premium) via xAI's OAuth device flow — no metered API key. Login happens in the chat: on first use the agent relays a verification link, the user approves in a browser, and tokens refresh automatically. The parent agent keeps ownership of the workspace, verification, and acceptance; Grok returns finished work products as text.
defaultPrompt: Use grok_delegate to hand this task to Grok and report its result with your own assessment.
Use grok_review to get an independent cross-vendor review of this diff, verify the findings against the code, and report what holds up.
